newsitem.title: USA: Del. Gov to sign bill creating Secy of Education.
newsitem.headline: Del. Gov to sign bill creating Secy of Education.

text.p: Delaware Gov. Thomas Carper said Monday he would sign legislation tomorrow creating a Secretary of Education for the state.
Carper said the move is "an effort to make the state's educational bureaucracy more directly accountable to the people of Delaware."

The bill was sponsored by Rep. Wayne Smith, R-Clair Manor, and Sen. Robert Voshell, D-Milford. It requires that the governor appoint the state's highest ranking education official, subject to confirmation by the state Senate.
